pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship Over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Use Stewardship Over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Stewardship Over Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship Over Creation.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Sinai Covenant? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Sinai Covenant has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Sinai Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Sinai Covenant.
   D. Use The Sinai Covenant to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Redemption after the Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Use Redemption after the Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Redemption after the Fall of Man.
   C. Say Redemption after the Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean ? (1 mark)
   A. Use The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean .
   D. Say The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Exodus? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Exodus to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The Exodus has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Exodus.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Bible.
   B. Say The Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Background of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background of Prophet Amos.
   C. Use Background of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Background of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books? (1 mark)
   A. Say The New Testament Books has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The New Testament Books to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books.
   D. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Old Testament Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Old Testament Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Old Testament Prophets has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Old Testament Prophets.
   D. Use The Old Testament Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Stewardship Over Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Exodus and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Sinai Covenant and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Loyalty to God and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. B — Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Apply the teaching of The Sinai Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

8. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

9. D — Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. D — Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of The Old Testament Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Stewardship Over Creation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Exodus; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Sinai Covenant; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Loyalty to God; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
